messages:
Eve H: Noticed weird WS churn after the last routing tweak. Clients reconnect but console still shows the original session as open for ~20s. Anyone seen this?
Carlos V: Yup. Looks like we send an app-level close (1001) to drain the worker but we keep TCP open until drain_window ends. Browsers treat that as a full close -> instant reconnect.
Nora P: Can you paste a quick snippet from edge logs?
Carlos V: snippet (sanitized):
```
edge-3 | conn=xyz | ws_frame=close code=1001 | upstream=worker-12 | drain=true
worker-12 | conn=xyz | marking: app_shutdown
edge-3 | conn=xyz | tcp_alive_ms=21000 | control_plane_session=OPEN
```
Eve H: That tcp_alive_ms is what's confusing console counts. Console only listens to socket open/close events from control plane. We need an app_close event.
Nora P: Agreed. UX: add a column "app-close observed" in the live session view and surface fast-reconnects (reconnect < 300ms) as a separate metric.
Carlos V: Short fix: emit control-plane webhook/event when app_close occurs so console and billing can reconcile.
Eve H: Billing question: are customers billed for both the old draining socket and the new one? If yes, this could double-charge during rollouts.
deploy-bot: billing-query: recent_fast_reconnects(conn=xyz) -> 2 events, charge_events -> 1 token stream event.
Nora P: Looks like billing uses token-streams, not socket lifecycle. But some downstream jobs triggered twice because SDK retry logic kicks in on reconnect. We should add SDK debounce to ignore reconnects within 200ms if server set header "x-graceful-restart: 1".
Carlos V: I'll backfill an "app_close_event" metric (edge) and add a 1% sampling of raw frame timings to help diagnose chunk vs genuine silence.
Eve H: Also revert the recent routing change on the next canary until we have SDK debounce + app_close metric in place. Could cause noisy telemetry for customers.
Nora P: I'll add a small dashboard tile: "App-close vs TCP-close mismatch" with alerts if mismatch_rate > 0.2% sustained for 5m.
Carlos V: WIP PR for app_close metric -> tagging canary eu-central.
Eve H: thanks. We'll follow up after canary results.
